_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Jig/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The hutch (hutch_*) and the fitted parts (sieve_: the sieve; shaft_ / stand_: the shaft and its standards; sheave_ / plunger_: the eccentric and the plunger; infeed_: the infeed chute and feed trough; outlet_: the tailings and concentrate chutes; pipecopper_ / pipelead_: the water inlet in each metal), and what it holds (watersieve_ / waterplunger_: the water; bed_: the ore bed). Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
